findings.title: Minor release breaks compilation for consumers that encrypt nullable-typed Json values
findings.label: valid
findings.note:
Correctly shows that EncryptResult

plus P defaulting to PlaintextForColumn makes Json-column encrypt results nullable, a compile-breaking type change in a minor release; it proposes a semver review and running the typecheck.

findings.title: Supabase per-term fallback now throws where it used to send a "null" operand
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: The new null-envelope check in encryptGroupPerTerm is real, but it is an intended fail-closed improvement on a narrow fallback path, so it adds no release risk.
